name: What is the process for installing a sliding glass door?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing a sliding glass door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process typically begins with an on-site consultation and measurement. Once the door is ordered, the installation involves careful removal of the old door (if applicable) or preparation of the new opening. The new door frame is then secured, leveled, and sealed to prevent drafts and leaks. Finally, the glass panels are installed, and any necessary trim work or finishing touches are completed. We ensure proper flashing and weatherproofing for lasting performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, measurement, removal/preparation, securing the new frame, installing panels, and finishing with trim and weatherproofing.
